faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.sub: Everything you might want to know before your first round.
faq.dataA: On your device and in your personal iCloud. RoundFair has no servers and no access to your data.
faq.shareA: Sessions can be shared through iCloud (CloudKit); everyone needs an iCloud account on their device.
faq.costA: RoundFair is free to download on the App Store. Open it and start a session — no purchase required to get going.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy — RoundFair
privacy.description: RoundFair collects no data. None. No analytics, no trackers, no ads, no servers — everything stays on your device and in your personal iCloud.
privacy.intro: RoundFair is built so that your data never leaves your control. There are no analytics, no trackers, no ads, no third-party SDKs, and no servers operated by RoundFair.
privacy.whereBody: Everything you enter in RoundFair — sessions, friends, rounds, locations, and prices — is stored on your device and in your personal iCloud (CloudKit). RoundFair has no servers and no access to any of it.
privacy.shareBody: When you share a session with friends, the sharing happens directly between participants' iCloud accounts through Apple's CloudKit. No data passes through anyone else.
privacy.photosBody: Photos for locations are added through the system photo picker. RoundFair only receives the single image you choose — never access to your photo library.
privacy.notifBody: Any notifications RoundFair shows are scheduled locally on your device. Nothing is sent from a server.
privacy.deleteIntro: Your data is yours to remove at any time:
privacy.deleteLi1: Delete a session to remove it and its rounds.
privacy.deleteLi2: Delete the app to remove all data from your device and your iCloud.
